items.docs:
Retrieves the daily telemetry for a single EV Charger.
The number of data points returned in the response corresponds to
days spanned between the start_date and end_date parameter mentioned in the request.

params.name: system_id
params.description: The unique numeric ID of the system

params.name: serial_no
params.description: Serial Number of the EV Charger

params.name: granularity
params.description: The granularity of the telemetry data. Possible values are 'week', 'day'. Default is 'day'

params.name: start_date
params.description: Requested start date of the time series data. If the start_date and start_at is not provided, then the response data begins with the previous date as start_date. Pass as String date format YYYYMMDD.

params.name: start_at
params.description: Start time for fetching the telemetry data in Epoch time format. Alternatively one can use start_date in place of start_at for passing the start date as String in YYYYMMDD format. By default start_at will appear in response. If start_date parameter is passed in the url, then start_date field will appear in response.

items.docs:
Retrieves telemetry for single EV Charger.
If no start_at is specified, defaults to previous days date, in the timezone of the system.
The end_at is calculated as the minimum of the time of the request and (start time + granularity).
